Links that keep up with renames, visible progress for long work, and AI agents in live notes.

### 🚀 Features
- **Links follow renames.** Rename a note and `[[links]]` to it update; change your username and @mentions follow.
- **See what's running.** Buttons show when they're waiting on the server, and longer jobs show progress in a corner activity dock.
- **Agents can edit live notes.** Edits made with an API key merge into an open note in real time and show up in presence under the key's name.

### 🧰 Self-hosting
- `GET /api/notes/{id}` returns an `ETag`; PUT with `If-Match` to merge into a live note, or `PATCH /api/notes/{id}/sections` to edit by heading.
- Email notices are sent in the background, so requests never wait on SMTP.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.8...v0.4.9](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.8...v0.4.9)
